label: No clear answer or still unsure
definition: The AI could not say what it was, or they were left uncertain.
status: kept (G14); coded for every chat that is not Yes

label: Needed a real doctor
definition: They say only a doctor could answer, or that they still need a doctor to check. Wondering whether to see a professional while still unsure is W1.
status: kept (G14); coded for every chat that is not Yes

label: Too much or hard-to-read information
definition: The answer was too long, too technical or hard to use.
status: kept (G14); coded for every chat that is not Yes

label: Still in progress
definition: The conversation is ongoing and the goal is not finished yet (used with Unclear).
status: kept (G14); coded for every chat that is not Yes

label: Hedged, nothing named as missing
definition: They said "mostly" or similar but did not say what was missing.
status: kept (G14); coded for every chat that is not Yes

label: AI could not do an extra task
definition: The AI could not do something extra they asked for (for example, make a PDF).
